## Config 命令

- [config 命令](https://wenliu197.github.io/Cerulean-Toolkit/config-%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4/config.md): config 命令是管理程序配置相关命令的父命令，它的子命令可以完成查看、设定、重置配置的工作
- [list-config 命令](https://wenliu197.github.io/Cerulean-Toolkit/config-%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4/list-config.md)
- [set-config 命令](https://wenliu197.github.io/Cerulean-Toolkit/config-%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4/set-config.md)
- [reset-config 命令](https://wenliu197.github.io/Cerulean-Toolkit/config-%E5%91%BD%E4%BB%A4/reset-config.md)
